browser_contexts: Fresh dedicated context per capture/check; no native Codex child or user browser access inferred

limitations: Shared filesystem/host and system/tool catalog, with instructed disjoint workspaces rather than OS isolation.
Role instructions are read in independent ordinary agents; no native agentRole binding is available or claimed.
Connected browser cannot reach executor localhost; actual app tests use pinned dedicated subprocess browser.

Full hidden session stream/reasoning is not available or exported. Retained original subprocess bytes and captured tool responses are the actual available raw evidence; faithful coordination exports are labeled.
Single execution per cell supports bounded findings, not population-wide effectiveness or model rankings.
Network state can drift; retain errors and source revisions.
Known older raw historical evidence remains unuploaded; current evidence does not reconstruct it.
dependency_policy: T2 package-lock.json is authoritative. Each cell receives a separate copy of the same prepared node_modules dependency tree; dependency/cache files are excluded from source snapshots and may be reinstalled with npm ci. No application state or browser profile is shared.
